Lina P: Handing off MarisTech to CS — closed yesterday. Deal details: Dedicated cluster (private VPC), US+EU regions, audit logging requirement, initial usage estimate ~4M tokens/month with irregular nightly bulk imports. Renewal: Jan 2027 (10mo). Main contact: Marco (marco@maristech.io). Sales notes: theytested embeddings pipeline; observed intermittent 503s during large parallel imports. Please pick up onboarding + triage. @Jordan M can you lead?

Jordan M: Taking lead. Quick checklist request: do we have their IdP metadata and a list of expected IP ranges? Need to loop in Eng for the 503s. Marco please drop SSO metadata and a sample ingestion job.

Lina P: Marco said security team will share IdP metadata by Wednesday. IP ranges coming from infra team later today. Iuploaded the signed contract to the shared folder: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/maris-contract>.

Jordan M: Plan: 1) kickoff call + product demo (30m) 2) create ENG ticket to investigate 503s during parallel imports 3) create SUP ticket for monitoring/alerting and incident runbook 4) deliver operator runbook + short training session for their ops team.

EnableBot: Created onboarding task "maristech-kickoff" and scheduled for 2026-04-02. Task ID: ONB-721.

Jordan M: Tentative owners: CS lead Jordan M; Engineering owner Priya R; Support lead Kai T; Enablement docs Jordan M.

Priya R: Iwill take ENG-1023 to repro the 503s. Initial hypothesis: connection pool exhaustion or ingress throttling on bulk workers. Can we get a sample of their import job (concurrency + batch size)? Also confirm whether they used KV cache and streaming options.

Kai T: Ill set up monitoring dashboards for MarisTech: request rate, 5xx rate, token-queue depth, and long-tail latency. Ill also draft an incident playbook for bulk-import failures and alert thresholds.

Jordan M: Marco if you can provide one sample ingestion job (script or k8s job manifest) that would help Priya repro. Also tell us whether imports run from within their VPC or via public egress.

Marco (customer): Ishared a sanitized manifest in the folder and noted imports run from their self-hosted workers inside their VPC. Sending IdP metadata now.

Lina P: Sales note: flagged renewal risk medium-high (7/10) due to reliability sensitivity. They mentioned procurement will consider credits if issues persist.

Jordan M: Action items: - Jordan: schedule kickoff + send invite (due 2026-04-01) - Priya: ENG-1023 repro & root-cause attempt (ETA 72h) - Kai: SUP-432 monitoring + runbook (ETA 48h) - Lina: confirm IP ranges + follow up on IdP if not received (by EOD) - EnableBot: keep tasks updated.

Priya R: Started ENG-1023: will run a controlled import from our staging env simulating their concurrency pattern. If pool limits are hit, I'll propose: a) temporary ingress-burst allowance b) increase worker backoff + retry jitter c) guidance on connection pooling.

Kai T: SUP-432 created and assigned to me. Blocking on sample job to calibrate alerts.

Jordan M: We'll prepare a short operator guide covering: recommended batch sizes, connection reuse, KV cache config, fallback model mapping. Jordan will run a 45m enablement session with their ops team after kickoff.

Lina P: If ENG finds it's on our side, sales can discuss short-term commercial remediation (credits or a dedicated remediation window) to protect renewal.

Priya R: Quick debug tip I'll include in ENG ticket: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"x"}' https://private.maris.redwood/api/generate

Kai T: Added dashboard tile to "MarisTech - Dedicated" for 5xx spikes and queue depth.

Jordan M: I'll also add a 30-/60-day satisfaction checkpoint to CRM and capture any enablement feedback in the shared doc. Closing this thread for now; will reopen with kickoff notes.

Lina P: Thanks team :clap: ping me if you need sales to surface contract language or procurement contacts.
